itineraries.title: Five days from Venice into the lagoon
itineraries.intro: Arrive in Venice by water, then the lagoon islands and the Istrian coast across the gulf.

days.note: Board at San Giorgio; the Grand Canal at dusk.
The Lido and the lagoon’s outer beaches.
The little Venice at the lagoon’s southern end.
A last morning in the city; disembark.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Venice to Istria
itineraries.intro: Venice, its lagoon and the Venetian towns of the Istrian coast.

days.note: Arrive by water along the Giudecca canal; a quiet evening after the day visitors leave.
The painted houses and the lace workshops, with Torcello’s basilica across the water.
The lagoon town and its beaches; a slow evening in the old quarter.
Cross to Istria: the Euphrasian Basilica.
The old town on its headland; swims in the Rovinj islands.
The Roman arena; disembark in Pula or return to Venice.
